wages.text: Her campaign emphasizes unions and worker rights, and her biography says she advocated for fair wages and stronger labor-law enforcement.
wages.quote: Served as a federal union officer, advocating for worker protections, fair wages, and stronger enforcement of labor law.

trade.text: She called tariffs a problem and said Congress should reclaim authority over them.
trade.quote: Congress needs to take back its power and say ... tariffs are up to us, Trump.

debt.text: She proposes lifting the Social Security payroll tax cap to fund the program and increase benefits.
debt.quote: An important strategy for protecting Social Security and Medicare for Kansas families is raising or scrapping the cap on what people put into contribute right now.

housing.text: Her economic plan identifies expanding housing supply as a way to address inflation.
housing.quote: It also addresses inflation without sacrificing jobs by coordinating fiscal policy with the Federal Reserve, expanding housing and energy supply, and targeting overheated sectors rather than imposing broad, blunt austerity.

schools.text: She said federal funding should help community schools stay open and educators keep their jobs.
schools.quote: I will demand that the federal government do its part to fund our schools — so that community schools stay open, educators keep their jobs, and all of our children have an excellent education.

health.text: She supports expanded Medicaid coverage, restored ACA tax credits, and adding a public insurance option.
health.quote: I will be a steadfast supporter of policies and bills that ensure expanded Medicaid coverage, the return of ACA tax credits, and adding a public option, so that all Kansans — and all Americans — can be insured.

tax.text: Mann backed a House bill that he said would lower taxes and reduce federal spending.
tax.quote: bringing down everyday costs, reining in our federal spending, lowering taxes, rolling back burdensome regulations

wages.text: Mann voted against the Protecting the Right to Organize Act, which would strengthen workers’ organizing rights.
wages.quote: Vote Question: On Passage Protecting the Right to Organize Act

trade.text: His campaign platform says free trade is important for expanding agricultural markets.
trade.quote: Free and fair trade is crucial for increasing demand for our livestock products and crops around the world.

safety.text: In his 2023 priorities, Mann called for hiring and retaining local law enforcement officers.
safety.quote: Support the hiring and retention of state and local law enforcement officers

immigration.text: Mann said he supports securing the southern border by constructing a wall.
immigration.quote: We must secure our southern border by constructing a wall. This is a national security issue, a human trafficking issue, a drug trafficking issue and just makes common sense.

guns.text: Mann described the right to bear arms as fundamental and said it is part of the nation’s constitutional foundation.
guns.quote: The right to bear arms is fundamental to our Bill of Rights and is part of the bedrock of what makes America exceptional in the world.

abortion.text: Mann said life begins at conception and that he would fight to protect unborn life.
abortion.quote: I believe that life begins at conception and will fight to protect the innocent life of the unborn.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He voted for the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act of 2023.
gender.quote: Vote Question: On Passage Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act

health.text: In announcing his campaign, he opposed efforts to impose government-run health care.
health.quote: Efforts to impose government-run health care, increase taxes, restrict religious freedom and erode the Second Amendment are part of the same agenda.

energy.text: Mann criticized the federal electric-vehicle mandate, citing energy costs for American families.
energy.quote: Rather than focus on reducing the record-high energy costs facing American families, the Biden-Harris Administration has again chosen to ignore the facts and focus on its radical climate agenda.
